note: Conceptual/architecture lesson tying together storage, skew, query selectivity, bulkification, and sharing recalculation into a unified performance-architecture view. No screenshots per this course's conceptual/architecture no-screenshot policy for Chapter 2 — taught through prose and a written lab scenario. This lesson deliberately states no specific numeric governor limits (e.g., SOQL-query-per-transaction caps), since those figures change across API versions and editions; the concepts referenced (query selectivity against indexed fields, bulkification, asynchronous Apex for large volumes, sharing recalculation cost) are foundational, well-established Salesforce platform behavior consistent with Salesforce's own large-data-volumes guidance already verified in Lesson 11's research.
